source_refs.note: Exercise 6.6, Question 1 (book p. 215-215); answer key PDF 308-309; checked with sympy

blocks.prompt: 1. A comet has a parabolic orbit with the sun at the focus. When the comet is 100 million km from the sun, the line joining the sun and the comet makes an angle of \(60^\circ\) with the axis of the parabola. How close will the comet get to the sun?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sawal bilkul Example 29 jaisa hai, bas ab \(h\) ki jagah number diya hai: \(h = 100\) million km aur angle \(30^\circ\) ki jagah \(60^\circ\).
Diya kya hai? Orbit parabola hai, sun focus par hai, comet sun se 100 million km door hai, aur sun-comet wali line axis ke saath \(60^\circ\) ka angle banati hai.
Find kya karna hai? Comet sun ke sab se qareeb kitna aayega. Parabola ka jo point focus ke sab se qareeb hota hai woh vertex hai, is liye jawab focus aur vertex ka faasla \(a\) hai.
Plan: right triangle se comet ke coordinates likhenge, parabola \(y^2 = 4ax\) mein rakhenge aur \(a\) nikalenge. Aakhir mein dekhenge ke comet sun ki doosri taraf bhi ho sakta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: orbit parabola hai, sun focus par; comet sun se 100 million km door; sun-comet line axis ke saath \(60^\circ\) banati hai.
Maloom karna: comet aur sun ka kam se kam faasla.
Tareeqa: Example 29 ki tarah orbit ko \(y^2 = 4ax\) lete hain aur sun ko focus \(S(a, 0)\) par. Vertex parabola ka woh point hai jo focus ke sab se qareeb hai, is liye jawab \(|OS| = a\) hoga. Hisaab aasaan rakhne ke liye hum sab faasle million km mein likhenge.

Comet ke coordinates (comet sun se aage, jaise Figure 6.30 mein)
Comet ko \(P(x, y)\) kahiye aur \(P\) se axis par perpendicular (amood) giraiye; uska foot \(Q\) hai.
\[x - a = 100\cos 60^\circ = 50\]
\[y = 100\sin 60^\circ = 50\sqrt{3}\]
Yani \(P = (a + 50,\ 50\sqrt{3})\).
Kyun: right triangle \(SQP\) mein hypotenuse \(SP = 100\) hai. Angle ke saath wali side (adjacent) \(SQ\) axis par hai, is liye \(\cos\) se milti hai; saamne wali side \(PQ\) height hai, is liye \(\sin\) se milti hai. \(SQ = x - a\) is liye ke \(Q\) ka x-coordinate \(x\) hai aur \(S\) ka \(a\).
Dhyan dein: \(\cos 60^\circ = \frac{1}{2}\) aur \(\sin 60^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\); in dono ko ulta likhna aam ghalti hai.

Parabola ki equation mein rakhein
\[(50\sqrt{3})^2 = 4a(a + 50)\]
\[7500 = 4a^2 + 200a\]
\[a^2 + 50a - 1875 = 0\]
Kyun: comet orbit par hai, is liye uske coordinates equation ko satisfy karte hain. \((50\sqrt{3})^2 = 2500 \times 3 = 7500\). Phir poori equation ko 4 se divide kiya taa ke numbers chhote ho jayein.

Quadratic hal karein
\[(a + 75)(a - 25) = 0\]
\[a = 25 \text{ ya } a = -75\]
Kyun: humein do aise numbers chahiye jinka product \(1875\) aur farq \(50\) ho: \(75\) aur \(25\). Faasla kabhi negative nahi hota, is liye \(a = -75\) chhor dete hain aur \(a = 25\) lete hain.

Focal distance se jaldi tasdeeq
\[SP = x + a = (a + 50) + a\]
\[100 = 2a + 50\]
\[a = 25 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: parabola ki definition yeh hai ke har point ka focus se faasla, directrix \(x = -a\) se faasle ke barabar hota hai. Point \(P(x, y)\) ka directrix se faasla \(x + a\) hai. Yeh shortcut quadratic ke baghair wohi jawab de deta hai, is liye exam mein check ke liye bahut kaam ka hai.

Doosri mumkin position
Axis ek seedhi line hai, is liye \(SP\) us ke saath \(60^\circ\) vertex wali taraf bhi bana sakti hai. Tab \(Q\) point \(O\) aur \(S\) ke darmiyan hoga:
\[x - a = -50\]
\[7500 = 4a(a - 50)\]
\[a^2 - 50a - 1875 = 0\]
\[(a - 75)(a + 25) = 0\]
\[a = 75\]
Kyun: triangle wohi hai, bas \(Q\) ab \(S\) ke doosri taraf hai, is liye \(x - a\) negative aaya. Tasdeeq: \(x = 75 - 50 = 25 > 0\) aur \(SP = x + a = 25 + 75 = 100\) \(\checkmark\).
Dhyan dein: sawal yeh nahi batata ke comet sun ki kis taraf hai, is liye dono jawab sahi hain. Kitab ke Example 29 aur Figure 6.30 wali soorat pehli hai.
blocks.final_answer: 25 million km (comet sun se aage, Example 29 aur Figure 6.30 wali soorat). Agar comet sun ki vertex wali taraf ho to kam se kam faasla 75 million km hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key sirf 75 million km deti hai. Sawal yeh nahi batata ke comet sun ki kis taraf hai. Kitab ke apne Example 29 (Figure 6.30, comet sun se aage) wala set-up lein to jawab 25 million km hai; 75 million km sirf tab sahi hai jab comet sun ki vertex wali taraf ho. Exam mein dono soortein likh dein to behtar hai.
